title: Sad set of plants - cancelled my subscription ☹️
text: The last few years have been the blossoming of our houseplant life and we love it. My husband thought this would be a fun subscription and I ran outside as soon as it was delivered. I was extremely disappointed with what was inside the box. For $27, we got about $6 worth plants and three of them were not doing so well. The succulents were so teeny and their leaves soft. And the ivy was not doing well. The other plant seemed fine. I’m shocked to see what other people got inside their boxes while looking at some of the reviews. I was definitely expecting better quality plants,  bigger plants, and more plants than 4. We didn’t get this. Subscription cancelled.
label: negative
